claim_text: Optic pathway gliomas can develop in young children with NF1 shortly after normal neuroimaging, so screening MRI in asymptomatic children is of little value.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Nat Rev Dis Primers 2017; not in PMC). Statement made by the Gutmann 2017 Primer citing ref 111 Listernick 1994 PMID 8021787; ref 112 King 2003 PMID 12955759; ref 113 Listernick 1992 PMID 1403395. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Review notes a longitudinal study (ref 111) failed to find tumors whose early detection altered clinical course; the National NF Foundation Optic Pathway Task Force recommended against routine screening neuroimaging (ref 108).
independence_flags: secondary citation via review PMID 28230061 of ref 111, ref 112, ref 113
